label: I — Strategic
description: Indonesia's 2nd NDC (submitted 24 Oct 2025) explicitly references Article 6.2 and 6.4 with operational blue carbon scope across mangroves, seagrass and salt marshes. The Blue Carbon Ecosystems Roadmap and 2025–2030 RENAKSI National Action Plan were launched at COP30 Belém on 17 Nov 2025 by MoE and MMAF. Strategic intent for both compliance (Art.6) and voluntary market participation is clearly stated, including the SPE-GRK certificate framework for international transfers under UNFCCC Art.6.4.

label: II — Legal
description: Presidential Regulation No. 110/2025 on Nilai Ekonomi Karbon (Carbon Economic Value) replaces PR 98/2021. PR 110/2025 establishes the legal architecture for the CA (Corresponding Adjustment) mechanism, ITMO authorization procedures, the SRUK national registry, and 2026–2030 carbon allocation ceilings. The Ministry of Environment (MoE) is designated as the Designated National Authority (DNA) for Article 6. Blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, seagrass, and as of 2025 salt marshes and tidal wetlands) are covered under MOMAF Regulation 1/2025.

label: III — Institutional
description: The Directorate General of Climate Change Control under MoE hosts DNA functions. MMAF (Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries) leads ocean/coastal data via the SIDAKO Ocean Accounting platform. The Ministry of Finance handles Letter of Authorization issuance under MoF Reg 6/2026. 51 JCM (Joint Crediting Mechanism) projects already operate in Indonesia; cross-ministry coordination established via the National Carbon Economic Value Steering Committee.

label: IV — Operational
description: MoF Regulation No. 6/2026 sets the Letter of Authorization procedure for ITMO transfers. The JCM MRA with Japan (Oct 2024) provides a working corresponding-adjustment template covering SPE-GRK ↔ JCM credit equivalence. Mutual Recognition Agreements with Plan Vivo (Sep 2024), Global Carbon Council (Sep 2024) and Verra (2024) operationalise voluntary-market alignment with SRN. Project submission and validation portals are partially digitised — Public ITMO ledger and end-to-end project pipeline tooling are still being built out.

label: V — Infrastructure
description: Dual-registry architecture: SRN-PPI (Sistem Registri Nasional — Pengendalian Perubahan Iklim) is the public national registry; SRUK is the ITMO sub-registry stood up under PR 110/2025. MRV via SIGN-SMART (the national MRV platform). Reporting capability demonstrated by Indonesia's BTR1 submission to UNFCCC. SIDAKO ocean accounting framework (KKP) is in development for marine/coastal NDC integration. SRN-PPI portal periodically offline for maintenance; public download capability for some datasets remains constrained.
